channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Josh Smith | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Josh Smith from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Josh Smith
item.description:
Daryl Morey:

“We didn't want [Josh Smith] to leave. We actually offered him more money [than the Clippers].(...) We're happy to bring him back.”

Daryl Morey on Josh Smith, Feb 9, 2016. Source: 95.7 The Game.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Josh Smith
item.description:
Mark Berman:Daryl Morey on landing Josh Smith:

“When he had his pick of 29 teams, our owner, our coach, our environment, our winning, all came into play”

Daryl Morey on Josh Smith, Apr 17, 2015. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: DeMarre Carroll on Josh Smith, Jeff Teague
item.description:
“If they were quiet and just did what they did, they wouldn’t have woke up Jeff Teague, they wouldn’t have woke up myself, they wouldn’t have woke up Paul (Millsap). I think that’s when it got chippy and Josh Smith was doing all this.”

DeMarre Carroll on Josh Smith, Jeff Teague, Mar 4, 2015. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Josh Smith
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Van Gundy on Pistons' play after Smith move was made:

“I don't think we expected to take a step back when we made that move.”

Stan Van Gundy on Josh Smith, Jan 6, 2015. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaPS.

item.title: Dwight Howard on Josh Smith
item.description:
MoreDwight Howard on Josh Smith:

“Have I been in his ear? Yeah, I've been in his ear. The only thing I told him was that if you want to win this would be a great place for you. We've won together in AAU. Let's try to get us 1 N the big leagues”

Dwight Howard on Josh Smith, Dec 23, 2014. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Josh Smith
item.description:
Bryan Gutierrez:Cuban on Josh Smith:

“He fits the profile of the type of guys we love to bring in.”

Mark Cuban on Josh Smith, Dec 22, 2014. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Larry Drew on Josh Smith
item.description:
Hawks CoachLarry Drew:

“I spoke to Josh Smith and he's excited to be a part of the Atlanta Hawks.”

Larry Drew on Josh Smith, Jul 13, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Tracy McGrady on Josh Smith
item.description:
McGrady wrote, referring to Smith by his nickname.

“Josh Smith is one of the best forwards n the East and deserves to be there!”

Tracy McGrady on Josh Smith, Feb 10, 2012. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Rick Sund on Josh Smith
item.description:
With speculation having swirled this month, the Atlanta forward said Hawks general manager Rick Sund told him there are no plans to deal him.

“They told me that it was all false,'' Smith said Monday in an interview with FanHouse about the trade rumors.”

Rick Sund on Josh Smith, Nov 22, 2010. Source: FanHouse.com.
